correctness_confidence.basis: All proofs were checked line-by-line and verified sound. Lean 4.36.0 (lean -DwarningAsError=true) typechecks all 20 theorems with zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, and zero custom axioms, using only [propext, Quot.sound] or no axioms. All 16 SHA-256 certificates match MANIFEST.json (2afa9455...) and paper.pdf (5ca4e3a0...). Zero-float Q and multi-prime F_q rank certificates rigorously establish all stated bounds.

novelty.basis: Uniformly resolves rank (2D-2) and border rank (D+1) for spin factors J_D (D>=3) via a rational (D+1)-cube degeneration and recursive (3/5,4/5) Pythagorean splitting. Proves a universal Strassen ceiling for commutative trace algebras, saturates it on Sym_n (n=2..7) with diagonal slices, breaks it on Sym_3 via Koszul p=2, and gives multi-degree Koszul staircases on so_5 and sl_3 plus a 25-product sl_3 algorithm. Tools are classical and literature review is sparse.

reproducibility.basis: Exemplary two-layer verification stack: dependency-free Lean 4.36.0 formalization (20 constructive theorems) plus an AST-audited pure-stdlib Python verifier (int/Fraction only, zero floats, zero / and **) generating 16 deterministic SHA-256 certificates cross-checked by 56 adversarial pytest checks. Both paper.pdf and MANIFEST.json digests match exactly.

rigor.basis: Proofs are concise, elementary, and complete: exact nullity-1 analysis of K_1(T_{J_D}), 5-line substitution lower bound over char!=2, skew-adjoint parity argument for Strassen's ceiling, Zariski semicontinuity for A=I_n on Sym_n, and explicit Chevalley/Hodge decompositions. The manuscript accurately distinguishes paper proofs, Lean-checked identities, and exact rational/modular certificates without overclaiming.

significance.basis: Establishes sharp structural phenomena for non-associative complexity: unbounded rank/border-rank separation approaching factor 2 on J_D, an intrinsic ceiling on Strassen's commutator method for commutative trace algebras, and strict multi-degree Koszul escalation where Strassen's method is capped or universally blind. Open gaps remain on Sym_3 [9,14], so_4 [8,10], and sl_3 [13,25].

summary: This paper determines exact and improved bilinear rank and border-rank bounds across three non-associative algebra families. Theorem 1 completely resolves spin-factor Jordan algebras J_D (D>=3): Koszul p=1 gives R_under(J_D)>=D+1, matched by an explicit rational (D+1)-cube degeneration over Q(eps), while substitution and recursive (3/5,4/5) Pythagorean splitting give R(J_D)=2D-2 over Q, R, C, yielding separation D-3->inf and ratio ->2. Theorem 2 proves a universal Strassen commutator ceiling d+floor((d-1)/2) for any d-dimensional commutative algebra (char!=2) with a non-degenerate symmetric invariant bilinear form; on Sym_n, A=I_n saturates at d-ceil(n/2) while A=diag(1..n) attains the ceiling for n=2..7, and Koszul p=2 (rank 84/10) breaks Sym_3's ceiling 8 to prove R_under(Sym_3)>=9 alongside a 14-cube rational Waring identity for 4*tr(X^3). Theorem 3 notes Lie slices ad_X are always singular, resolves so_3 at 5 via a {0,+-1} algorithm, escalates so_4 (>=8, <=10), so_5 (12->13), and sl_3 (10->11->13), and gives a 25-product sl_3 decomposition. Lean 4.36.0 (20 theorems) and 16 zero-float certificates rigorously back the results. Minor caveats are sparse literature comparison (7 refs) and unweighted vs. weighted Q-Waring terminology.
strengths: Complete, self-contained resolution of exact rank (2D-2) and border rank (D+1) for spin-factor Jordan algebras J_D across all D>=3 over Q, R, and C, with zero irrational roots.

Clean, general proof of the universal Strassen commutator ceiling for any commutative algebra (char!=2) with a non-degenerate symmetric invariant bilinear form, explaining why A=I_n on Sym_n falls short for n>=5 while A=diag(1,...,n) saturates the ceiling.
Explicit Koszul p=2 breakthrough on Sym_3 (rank 84/10 => border rank >=9 > Strassen wall 8) paired with an exact zero-denominator 14-cube rational identity for 4*tr(X^3).

Multi-degree Koszul lower-bound escalations on classical Lie algebras where Strassen equations are universally blind (so_5: 12->13; sl_3: 10->11->13) and an explicit 25-product rational sl_3 algorithm.
Two-layer formal and exact computational verification: 20 axiom-clean Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates verified by 56 adversarial tests.
weaknesses: Sparse bibliography (only 7 classic references, newest from 2015) omits prior specialized literature on Lie algebra and Jordan algebra bilinear complexity, leaving exact novelty attribution for small cases (e.g., so_3) insufficiently contextualized.

Terminological nuance over Q: Eq. (6) writes R_under_Q^sym(J_D) = D+1, yet Eq. (7) uses scalar weights in Q(eps) that are not rational cubes; thus over Q(eps) it certifies weighted symmetric rank / ordinary tensor border rank D+1 (and unweighted symmetric border rank over R and C).
Exact values remain open with nontrivial gaps for Sym_3 ([9, 14]), so_4 ([8, 10]), and sl_3 ([13, 25]), and Sym_n Strassen ceiling attainment is only certified for n<=7.

Lean 4 formalizes polynomial/coefficient identities, inequalities, and the abstract commutative kernel identity (thm20), while general-D Koszul nullity/rank and skew-adjoint parity arguments remain paper-only or Python-certified.
strong_novelty_candidates: Purely rational (D+1)-cube border-rank degeneration F_{D,eps} over Q(eps) combined with recursive (3/5,4/5) Pythagorean splitting to prove exact separation R_Q(J_D) - R_under_C(J_D) = D-3 -> inf and ratio -> 2.
Universal commutative-trace Strassen ceiling theorem (commutator rank <= d-1 for odd d, d-2 for even d) and diagonal symmetry-breaking A=diag(1..n) strictly beating A=I_n on Sym_n for n>=5.
Koszul p=2 rank-84 certificate breaking Strassen's ceiling on Sym_3 alongside the 14-cube integral Waring identity for 4*tr(X^3).
Three-tier Koszul staircase on sl_3 (p=1,2,3 giving 10->11->13) paired with a 25-product decomposition into three sl_2 triples and two root cross-products.
